4. A course has many offerings (multiple sections)
6. A course can have many prerequisite groups
7. Each prerequisite group contains many prerequisite courses
8. Each prerequisite course references another course in COURSE
. PREREQUISITE_GROUPS includes a self-referencing foreign key for nested
